articles.title: Orcas Are Ramming Boats — And Scientists Think It's a Game
articles.summary: A small group of orcas keeps bumping into sailboats near Spain and Portugal — and even sinking some! Scientists think the whales might just be playing with the boats like toys.

articles.title: Taylor Swift's Big Cheer: 'That's My Husband!'
articles.summary: Taylor Swift jumped out of her seat and pointed at her wedding ring when Travis Kelce scored a touchdown. The Chiefs beat the Colts 33-30 in overtime.

articles.title: The Southern Taurids Are Here — Watch for Fireballs!
articles.summary: The Southern Taurid meteor shower runs from Sept. 20 to Nov. 20. It's slow and sparkly, with a chance of bright fireballs. Best nights: Oct. 13-14 and Nov. 4-5.
